Title: Shop owner updates appointment service status from PENDING to IN-PROGRESS
Preconditions: 1. Shop owner is authenticated and has a valid JWT token. 2. An existing appointment reservation with 'status' as 'ACTIVE' and 'serviceStatus' as 'PENDING' exists for the shop owner's shop.
Steps: 1. Send a PUT request to /api/shops/{shopId}/appointments/{id}?status=IN-PROGRESS with the JWT token in the 'Authorization' header. Use the shopId and appointment ID from the preconditions.
Expected Result: Response status code is 200. The response body contains the updated appointment reservation details with 'serviceStatus' as 'IN-PROGRESS'.
